subject: Request: exec exception for combined promo credits + discount — ZenHealth pilot
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@zenhealth.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Trial extension + promotional credits request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — the prototype is promising and the clinical team wants to extend the pilot. Procurement asked whether Redwood can: (1) extend our current 30-day trial to 90 days, and (2) provide $12,000 in promotional credits that would be applied during the pilot. We also asked about a first-year commercial discount (we’d like 20% off list) if we convert to a 12-month contract after pilot.

We have tight procurement windows — need approvals this week if possible. If you need a formal procurement note I can loop in David (CFO) and procurement@zenhealth.ai.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Data & AI, ZenHealth
Email: olivia@zenhealth.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Original usage snapshot attached for context.
(attachment: ZenHealth_usage_20260220.csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Trial extension + promotional credits request — request for exec exception

Team — forwarding the request from ZenHealth (below). They’re asking for a combined exception: 90-day pilot extension, $12k in credits, and a 20% first-year discount if they convert to a 12-mo contract. Quick context:
- Account: ZenHealth (mid-stage telehealth startup)
- Pilot usage looks like ~120k tokens/day projected (see attached snapshot)
- Upside: customer forecasts $180k ARR on conversion; strong reference potential in health vertical
- Procurement timeline: needs vendor approval this week to hit budget cycle

Ask: I’m requesting executive exception approval for the combined package. If we approve, I’ll capture terms in the SOW and have procurement sign.

Attachments: SOW draft (SOW_zenhealth_v1.2.pdf), usage CSV. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (deal HZ-2026-037).

Options I can present to customer if we need conservative tiering:
- Option A (ideal): 20% off Y1 + $12k credits + 90-day trial
- Option B (compromise): 15% off Y1 + $8–10k credits + 60-day trial

Please reply with: approve / need changes / reject. If approve, indicate final credit cap and discount.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-2233

(attachment: SOW_zenhealth_v1.2.pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension + promotional credits request — request for exec exception

Marissa — quick clarifying Qs before I can sign off:
1) Is the $180k ARR a committed forecast tied to a PO or just an internal projection?
2) What term length would we require to protect unit economics (12 months minimum?)
3) Will credits be applied as platform credits (reduces invoice) or do they need an invoiced credit note? Procurement sometimes insists on applied credits vs. internal promo codes.

If this is net-new ARR and they are willing to sign 12mo, I’m leaning toward a constrained approval (15% + $10k credits) to preserve margin. If you’ve got strong upsell evidence and a PO, we can push to 20% + $12k. Also recommend a clause: credits expire after 180 days and do not roll into paid consumption.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra, Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

On Mon, Feb 23, 2026 at 10:03 AM Olivia Park <olivia@zenhealth.ai> wrote:
> (quoted) Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — the prototype is promising and the clinical team wants to extend the pilot...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension + promotional credits request — request for exec exception

Thanks Rishi — answers inline below and additional context:

1) $180k ARR is the customer’s forecast for year-one if they convert to a 12-month commercial contract; they’ve signaled budget but have not issued a PO yet. They do have a pilots budget line and CFO (David) is engaged.
2) We should require 12-month minimum on conversion. For the pilot approval I’ll add language that credits are limited to the pilot period and only applied if contract executed by X date.
3) Procurement preference: they prefer applied credits on invoice. If finance requires a credit note we can accommodate — Stephanie can confirm.

Proposal I recommend we present (to move quickly):
- Final ask to customer: 20% off Y1 + $12k promotional credits + 90-day pilot extension
- Our terms: credits expire 180 days after issuance, credits can be used only for pilot usage, conversion requires 12-month MSA with minimum committed spend (to be written in SOW)
- Contingency: if finance/legal pushback, fallback = 15% + $10k credits + 60-day extension

HubSpot notes and SOW draft in the link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567. I’ll attach the SOW for legal redline (SOW_zenhealth_v1.2.pdf).

If you can OK the 20% + $12k today I’ll communicate to them and start the DocuSign flow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
marissa@redwood.ai
(attachment: SOW_zenhealth_v1.2.pdf, ZenHealth_usage_20260220.csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension + promotional credits request — request for exec exception

Marissa — appreciate the detail. Given health vertical reference value and speed to close, I approve a constrained exception: 15% off Y1 + $10k promotional credits and a 60-day extension — conditional on a signed 12-mo commitment within 45 days of pilot end and credit expiry set to 180 days.

I want finance to confirm we’re covered on unit economics for the first six months under that concession. Stephanie, can you run a quick margin check and confirm whether credits applied on invoice vs. credit note changes the financial impact materially?

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni, Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

(For the record, prefer not to set a precedent of both 20% + $12k unless there is a signed PO.)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial extension + promotional credits request — request for exec exception

Marissa — after thinking about reference value and probability of expansion into payer partnerships, I will authorize the full exception: 20% off year-one + $12,000 promotional credits + 90-day extension, on the conditions you outlined:
- Credits expire 180 days after issuance and apply only to pilot usage
- Conversion requires a 12-month MSA with minimum committed spend to be captured in SOW
- PO or signed commitment to be returned within 45 days of pilot completion or credits are void

Please proceed to get DocuSign started and copy finance on the SOW. Marissa — once signed, log the concession in the deal record (HubSpot) and mark reason = strategic reference.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett, VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.ai

Marissa later sent final customer note confirming approvals; thread continues in the mailbox but this thread captures the exec approval sequence.

Hi Olivia / David / ZenHealth procurement — good news: Redwood can approve the pilot package as requested. Summary of approved terms (conditional):

- Pilot: 90-day extension from current trial end
- Promotional credits: $12,000 applied to pilot usage (credits expire 180 days after issuance)
- Commercial: 20% off year-one list pricing if ZenHealth executes a 12-month contract within 45 days of pilot completion; minimum committed spend will be captured in the SOW
- Credits will be applied on the invoice; if procurement needs a different mechanism we can accommodate a credit note (finance will confirm)

Next steps: I’ll send the SOW via DocuSign (https://www.docusign.net/zenhealth-sow). Please review and return the signed SOW or PO within 45 days of pilot completion to preserve credits.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — we’re excited to support ZenHealth on this pilot.

Best,
